document.title: Preserving historic buildings
document.question:
Some people believe that old buildings in city centres should be preserved at any cost because they are part of a nation’s history. Others argue that they should be replaced with modern buildings that better meet people’s needs.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
